import numpy as np, os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def solve(D):
    D=np.array(D); vals,cnts=np.unique(D,return_counts=True); bg=int(vals[np.argmax(cnts)])
    H,W=D.shape
    # all closed rects of any single border color
    boxes=[]
    for bc in set(int(v) for v in D.flatten())-{bg}:
        for y1 in range(H):
            for x1 in range(W):
                if D[y1,x1]!=bc: continue
                for y2 in range(y1+2,H):
                    if not ((D[y1:y2+1,x1]==bc)&(D[y1:y2+1,x1]==bc)).all(): continue
                    for x2 in range(x1+2,W):
                        top=(D[y1,x1:x2+1]==bc).all()
                        bot=(D[y2,x1:x2+1]==bc).all()
                        left=(D[y1:y2+1,x2]==bc).all()
                        right=(D[y1:y2+1,x1]==bc).all()
                        if not (top and bot and left and right): continue
                        inter=D[y1+1:y2,x1+1:x2]
                        nz=int((inter!=bg).sum())
                        if nz<=0: continue
                        boxes.append((bc,(y1,y2,x1,x2),nz,inter.copy()))
    # pick frame with most noise; tie-break: largest bbox
    boxes.sort(key=lambda b:(-b[2], -b[3].size))
    bc,(y1,y2,x1,x2),nz,inter=boxes[0]
    ncol=next(int(v) for v in np.unique(inter) if v!=bg)
    nh,nw=inter.shape
    out=np.full((nh+2,nw+2),ncol,dtype=int)
    out[1:nh+1,1:nw+1]=inter
    return out.tolist()
